L_224.lesson_text: PIT-C13 (NEGATE_FACTORS forbidden) is NOT only process compliance — it is signal quality protection. Manual `-Q15_Debt_to_Equity` and `-Q05_Accrual` (assumed equivalent to Z_Score_Aligned for IC-stable factors) PRODUCED MATERIALLY DIFFERENT results: rank_ic 0.0188 (manual) vs 0.0382 (Aligned). Z_Score_Aligned uses expanding-window IC sign which captures regime changes; manual `-Z` assumes static sign. The 'equivalent for stable IC' assumption is FALSE in practice. Always use load_month_factors() + Z_Score_Aligned.

L_225.lesson_text: alpha_scores.parquet must ALWAYS be sig_date × Ticker × score time-series panel. Iter 4 + Iter 10 B both initially emitted single as-of snapshot (Date-less 344 rows). Codex catches via RF-A7. Default schema: sig_date + Ticker + score (+axis components). 50+ months span minimum.
